title: Cohen ring
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number. A *discrete valuation ring* is here a local principal ideal domain which is not a field. A *Cohen ring* (with residue characteristic $p$) is a discrete valuation ring $\Lambda$ whose maximal ideal is $p\Lambda$ (so $p\neq0$ in $\Lambda$ and $p$ is a uniformizer) and which is complete with respect to its maximal ideal: $\Lambda$ is $p\Lambda$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], i.e. the canonical map $\Lambda\to\varprojlim_n\Lambda/p^n\Lambda$ is bijective.
